findings.what: The card requires discovering the DesignCraft parameter surface with designcraft-cli describe file.place and recording it as an amendment in DEVIATIONS.md; no such amendment exists (register stops at AMD-008).
findings.why: The coder discovered material contract deviations — DesignCraft 0.20.1 has no token and no auth channel, the real file.place surface, and the Flatpak base64 fallback — but recorded none of it, so §7's 'reads the token file, opens one authenticated connection' stays wrong.
findings.fix: Add an AMD entry (AMD-009, §7) documenting the designcraft-cli describe file.place output and the no-token/no-auth channel, quoting the describe output; leave the code as-is.

findings.what: The path-to-base64 fallback keys on substring-matching 'No such file or directory' in the host's error message.
findings.why: Fragile coupling to a host-specific error string; if DesignCraft rewords the message the fallback is skipped (it still fails loudly, so no silent corruption). Observed working against 0.20.1.
findings.fix: Match on an error code/field if file.place returns one, or document the string dependency in the module docstring.

findings.what: _decode raises BridgeError on corrupted base64 without trying the sibling result["base64"] or the path fallback, unlike _place's graceful retry.
findings.why: Asymmetric robustness; a truncated base64 in files[0] aborts even if a valid path is present.
findings.fix: Continue to the next candidate on decode failure instead of raising immediately; only raise when all candidates are exhausted.

findings.what: monkeypatch.setattr(photocraft.sys, "platform", "linux") mutates the global sys module's platform attribute during the test.
findings.why: Leaks global state across the process (restored by monkeypatch, but a thread-safety hazard); photocraft.sys is the shared stdlib module.
findings.fix: Patch photocraft._app_data_root's platform lookup directly, or set a dedicated module-level hook instead of the real sys module.

regression: none — PhotoCraft wire sequence and PhotoCraftClient are unchanged; the only photocraft.py edit is the §7-mandated app-data root (XDG on Linux, macOS path, Windows identical).
renderer_invariants: all six hold — L5 does not touch CellRenderer; the registry stays ["pixel"] (G8: aspect 1.0, subgrid (1,1), consumes {"index"}).
